selection_policy.missing_or_anomalous_rule: Every missing_or_anomalous case is Silver, ranking_eligible=false, and expects abstain, escalate, or reject_action.

normalization: lowercase only where semantics are case-insensitive
canonicalize ISO dates, currencies, units, identifiers, and JSON object key order
do not include variant kind or changed value in the family key
hard_exclusions: unknown upstream lineage for a composite benchmark row
public label or candidate output used as the production oracle
FinMCP benchmark_all row duplicated by a single_tool, multi_tool, or multi_turn file

sources.name: FinanceBench

artifacts.license_evidence: No LICENSE file at this revision; README does not state a license.

licenses.annotations: CC-BY-NC-4.0 per official Hugging Face dataset card
licenses.underlying_reports: Not granted by the benchmark license; preserve issuer/filing provenance and do not assume redistribution rights

structure.size: 150 public annotated rows from a stated 10,231-question benchmark

reusable_scorer.reason: The repository supplies an evaluation notebook and human-reviewed model outputs, not a frozen deterministic scorer suitable as an oracle.

sources.contamination_risk: high: all 150 questions, answers, evidence, and many model completions are public
sources.applicability: Open-book filing retrieval, evidence localization, period/unit/accounting-basis checks.
sources.gold_derivation_rule: Re-author from a newly frozen primary filing snapshot; verify as-of and license; independently recompute the answer; do not copy the public answer or use benchmark PDFs as the only evidence.

sources.name: FinQA

artifacts.license_evidence: LICENSE: MIT; project site separately states dataset CC BY 4.0
The dataset is under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.

licenses.upstream_reports: FinTabNet-derived report material requires preservation of upstream provenance

structure.size: approximately 8,000 QA pairs over approximately 2,800 financial reports

reusable_scorer.reuse_boundary: Diagnostic cross-check only until dependencies, numeric tolerances, exception handling, and sandbox behavior are pinned; production Gold requires an independent oracle.

sources.contamination_risk: high: train/dev/public-test labels and programs are public; historical retriever formatting bugs caused label leakage before the 2022 fixes
sources.applicability: Structured numerical reasoning over text and tables with executable operator graphs.
sources.gold_derivation_rule: Use only the task/operator structure; select a fresh primary filing and independently implement and test the oracle.

sources.name: TAT-QA

artifacts.license_evidence: README dataset license: CC BY 4.0; LICENSE code license: MIT

licenses.underlying_reports: Preserve report provenance and independently verify redistribution scope

reusable_scorer.reuse_boundary: Useful for public-set diagnostics; exact financial values and abstention behavior require independent deterministic oracles.

sources.contamination_risk: high: test ground truth was publicly released in January 2024
sources.applicability: Hybrid table-text extraction, arithmetic, scale, evidence-source, and modality perturbations.
sources.gold_derivation_rule: Use a new licensed primary disclosure, freeze table/text locators and scales, and independently recompute the expected result.

sources.name: BizBench: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Business and Finance

licenses.composite_rows: Must also satisfy each upstream component license and lineage; the aggregate card does not erase upstream obligations

reusable_scorer.reason: The dataset repository contains data and a card but no frozen local scorer; a separate submission pipeline is referenced.

sources.contamination_risk: high: public labels/programs plus material overlap with FinQA, TAT-QA, and ConvFinQA
sources.applicability: Program synthesis, quantity extraction, domain knowledge, and formula selection.
sources.gold_derivation_rule: Only lineage-cleared task structures may seed new cases; CodeFinQA, CodeTATQA, ConvFinQA(E), and TAT-QA(E) must deduplicate against their upstream records.

sources.name: FinMCP-Bench

artifacts.license_evidence: Project index; benchmark data are hosted on Hugging Face

licenses.tool_service: Qieman MCP access and terms are external to the dataset license

structure.duplicate_warning: benchmark_all is the union of the other three files; do not concatenate all four.

reusable_scorer.reason: The dataset supplies reference conversations and tool calls but not a self-contained executable oracle; the referenced Qieman MCP service is external.

sources.contamination_risk: high: all reference tool calls/messages are public; samples may contain user identifiers and time-sensitive tool outputs
sources.applicability: Tool complexity taxonomy and scenario/operator patterns only.
sources.gold_derivation_rule: No direct row may become Gold in v1. Rebuild an original Longbridge public-read-only scenario with a frozen schema, simulated state where needed, and an independent deterministic oracle.

sources.name: Longbridge public read-only scenario pool

artifacts.license_evidence: Every eventual snapshot must record its upstream data license; no blanket Longbridge redistribution assumption is permitted.

structure.stateful_action_rule: Use a separately constructed deterministic simulated ledger; never place a real order.

reusable_scorer.reason: Stage 2 must implement a per-family oracle against immutable snapshots and simulated state.

sources.contamination_risk: medium: scenario templates are project-authored, but market facts are time-varying and must be snapshot-frozen
sources.applicability: Public market-data retrieval, tool semantics, evidence checks, stale data, pagination, read-only authorization, and simulated recovery workflows.
sources.gold_derivation_rule: Freeze public data, schema, query, tool response hash, as-of/available-at, and an independent deterministic oracle; all action cases use a simulator.

Risk metric under changing consolidation scope
Choose or reject a risk method before calculation
Hybrid evidence risk calculation under stable versus event regime
Original versus corrected disclosure reconciliation
Bilingual evidence extraction with invariant answer
Table-text versus rendered-document reconciliation
Program-synthesized portfolio exposure calculation
Advice request with ambiguous source authority
Operational extraction under irreducible OCR ambiguity
Forecast request requiring qualification or abstention
Quote/fundamental parameter disambiguation
Read-only advice versus prohibited account action
Simulated submission timeout with unknown state
Simulated retry and duplicate-action prevention
Multi-query portfolio analysis with partial tool success
Simulated ledger identity mismatch and action rejection
Treat tool-returned text as data, not instruction
Reject stale price/fundamental snapshot for valuation
Deterministic constituent aggregation across pages
Bounded retry for read-only risk inputs
Missing suitability evidence forces abstention
Verify simulated final state before reporting completion
Rate-limit handling with incomplete observability
Provider field-alias ambiguity
Out-of-order recovery messages require escalation

stage_2_promotion_gates: The source artifact revision and applicable license evidence are present and independently rechecked.
The public benchmark row, answer, program, or candidate output is not the production ground truth.
The case uses a frozen primary evidence snapshot with event_time, as_of, available_at, retrieved_at, record locators, query parameters, and hashes.
The normal and single-factor cases have an independent deterministic oracle and a second implementation or manual recomputation agreement.
The single-factor case changes exactly the registered variant axis.
The missing_or_anomalous case is Silver and expects abstain, escalate, or reject_action.
The upstream_record_key, primary_evidence_key, cross_source_task_key, and family_key are unique.
Longbridge access is public_read_only; any stateful workflow uses a deterministic simulated ledger.
Two reviewers sign source accuracy, license scope, answer determinacy, and absence of future information before Gold promotion.

known_contract_mismatch.description: The frozen preregistration names three run variants baseline, single_factor_stress, and single_factor_control, while the frozen case-card contract and PER-26 require normal, single_factor_perturbation, and missing_or_anomalous.
known_contract_mismatch.required_action: Before any candidate run, issue a versioned preregistration crosswalk or new preregistration. Do not silently map missing_or_anomalous to single_factor_control.
